articles.title: Attackers Heat French Supermarket Fridges Up to 50°C by Hijacking Danfoss Controllers
articles.text:
Attackers took remote control of fridges and freezers at hundreds of French supermarkets on the night of October 11 and warmed them, forcing stores to throw food away, several retail chains said.
The attackers reached them through the controller that runs all of a store's fridges and freezers, a device made by Danish company Danfoss that maintenance firms can manage remotely. Les Mousquetaires, which owns the Intermarché chain, said its fridges and freezers were put into defrost and heated to as much as 50°C.
CERT-FR, the French government's computer emergency response team, said in an alert published in French on October 12 that it is aware of numerous compromises affecting two Danfoss controller series, the AK-SM and the AK-SC. It told operators to disconnect the controllers or filter access to them.
CERT-FR is part of ANSSI, France's national cybersecurity agency. ANSSI's head, Vincent Strubel, called it urgent to take the two series off the internet or filter access very tightly, AFP reported.
Neither French authorities nor Danfoss has so far said who carried out the attack or how the attackers got into the controllers. Danfoss said most of the units hit were older models that it no longer updates.
Which Chains Were Hit
The chains gave their own figures to AFP, Reuters and broadcaster RTL. Each counts the stores the attack reached.
| Retailer | Stores Reported Hit | Source | 
|---|---|---|
| Intermarché and Netto (Les Mousquetaires) | At least 300 across both brands, per AFP. About 150 stores, per Reuters | Company statements, October 12 | 
| Coopérative U | 80 of 2,000 | Chief executive Dominique Schelcher, on RTL, October 13 | 
| Carrefour | 80 supermarkets | Company statements to AFP and Reuters, October 12 | 
| Monoprix | About 30 | Company statement to AFP, October 12 | 
| E.Leclerc | Several stores | Company statement to AFP, October 12 | 
A store on that list did not always lose its stock. Schelcher told RTL that the cold chain held in most of the 80 Coopérative U stores hit, and that only a minority could not react fast enough and lost goods, according to AFP. He praised the quick reaction of store staff and refrigeration contractors.
Intermarché, by contrast, said its affected stores had to throw away all the products concerned.
Thierry Cotillard, who heads Les Mousquetaires, told broadcaster BFMTV he expected losses of tens of millions of euros across France, according to Reuters.
In its statements on October 12, Danfoss gave no figure for how many systems were hit. It told Reuters it was "aware of incidents in France affecting a limited number of refrigeration management systems."
Which Controllers, and Whether They Can Be Patched
Danfoss told AFP that most of the units hit were older products that no longer get software or security updates, and it named two: the AK-SM 800 and the AK-SC 355.
Danfoss declared the AK-SM 800 end-of-life in May 2021 and phased out the AK-SC 355 in 2016. In an October 2025 newsletter, it said it would end all services for such older products and urged customers to plan replacements.
Some units of the current model, the AK-SM 800A, were also hit. Those were running outdated firmware, according to Danfoss's statement to trade publication Cooling Post, which did not name the versions.
| Controller | Status, According to Danfoss | Advice From CERT-FR and Danfoss | 
|---|---|---|
| AK-SM 800 | End of life since May 2021. No software or security updates | Disconnect it or filter access. Danfoss urges replacement | 
| AK-SC 355 | Phased out in 2016. No software or security updates | Disconnect it or filter access. Danfoss urges replacement | 
| AK-SM 800A | Current model. Package 5.3.x, dated October 2026, was the latest listed on October 13 | Disconnect it or filter access. Danfoss advises keeping firmware up to date | 
As of October 13, Danfoss's security advisories page listed no advisory about the attack or about either older model.
What Operators Should Do
CERT-FR's first instruction covers every AK-SM and AK-SC controller: disconnect it or filter access to it. Exposing a management interface to the internet goes against good practice, the alert says.
Where remote administration cannot be avoided, limiting access to trusted IP addresses is a first, temporary step. Beyond that, the alert advises following CERT-FR's hardening recommendations, which were written for the energy and water sector.
Where a controller may have been compromised, the alert lists six steps, in this order:
- Limit network access to the controllers to service providers only.
- Do a factory reset.
- Apply all available security fixes.
- Change the device's secrets, such as passwords.
- Check the existing accounts.
- Reconfigure the device completely.
Danfoss no longer issues fixes for the AK-SM 800 and the AK-SC 355, so the third step offers their owners no new fix.
For the AK-SM 800A, the latest software package Danfoss listed on October 13 was 5.3.x. A system on version 3.x should move to 4.x first, and a controller cannot be downgraded once it runs 5.3.x, according to the package's readme.
Starting with version 4.0, a setting called Strict Session Control is enabled by default and makes HTTPS mandatory. Danfoss's pages do not say whether the 5.3.x package was released in response to the attack.
Danfoss told Cooling Post it was working with customers on "firmware updates where available, stronger network protections and removing direct internet exposure where applicable."
Its general security guidance, published in French, also tells operators to keep controllers unreachable from the internet, change default passwords when a system is installed, and require remote users to log in through a single managed entry point.
CERT-FR had published no indicators of compromise as of October 13, so operators have no official signs to check for.
Coopérative U's stores do not buy directly from Danfoss. They are customers of refrigeration contractors that supply them with the Danfoss system, Schelcher said.
How the Attackers Got In Is Not Established
As of October 13, CERT-FR had named no vulnerability, no firmware version, and no way in. Its alert warns against exposing management interfaces to the internet without saying that was the route.
A person close to French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu told AFP that ANSSI had identified a vulnerability in software supplied by a Danish company and had contacted the vendor. No CVE was named, and the statement does not say the vulnerability was used in the attack.
E.Leclerc told AFP that a cyberattack had affected one of its refrigeration equipment suppliers, with effects on cold equipment in several of its stores. The supplier was not named.
Danfoss issued fixes for three flaws in the newer AK-SM 800A in 2025. Neither French authorities nor Danfoss has linked them to this attack.
CVE-2025-41450 is an authentication bypass, a way past the login, in versions before 4.2. CVE-2025-41451 is a command injection flaw that could lead to remote code execution, and CVE-2025-41452 could allow a denial-of-service attack. Both need a login and were fixed in version 4.3.1.
Researchers at Claroty described the three flaws in August, said they could be combined into attack chains, and reported finding thousands of AK-SM 800A management interfaces reachable from the internet. Their tests of the flaws were laboratory work on the newer model. The report describes no attacks and does not mention the two older models.
Danfoss's October 2025 newsletter records earlier attacks on the AK-SM 800: 16 Russian supermarkets using the model were targeted in 2022, and 40 Israeli stores were hacked the same year. All 40 lacked proper firewall or VPN protection, and the newsletter names no vulnerability in either case.
The Inquiry and Reports From Other Countries
The Paris prosecutor's office has opened an inquiry on its own initiative, it told AFP. Its cybercrime section leads the inquiry, which is assigned to the anti-cybercrime office known as OFAC.
The inquiry is to count the victims and establish the link between the attack and the damage they reported, which includes lost food and equipment that began to catch fire.
ANSSI is in contact with cybersecurity agencies in other European countries because those countries may be affected, the person close to the Prime Minister said.
Félix Aimé, a senior threat intelligence analyst at Sekoia, told Reuters that Spain, Portugal, Poland, Germany and Belgium had also been affected. Reuters gave no details on those cases.

articles.title: “Lo que diga la sede central es irrelevante. Somos PlayStation”, confiesa exdirectivo cuando diseñaba la PS3, PS4 y PS Vita
articles.text:
Kazuo Hirai, exjefe de PlayStation admitió que durante su conducción ignoraba las directrices de la sede central para preservar la autonomía del negocio de consolas, una postura que más tarde trasladó a la reestructuración de toda la compañía.
“Cuando era presidente de Sony Computer Entertainment y gestionaba el negocio de consolas de sobremesa de PlayStation, cada vez que Howard Stringer y los demás ejecutivos me decían esto o aquello, yo me iba por mi propio camino diciendo: ‘Lo que diga la sede central es irrelevante. Somos PlayStation’”, relató Hirai en una entrevista con Nikkei XTrend.
La división de videojuegos funcionaba con un margen de independencia dentro de Sony que Hirai utilizaba para proteger las decisiones de PlayStation frente a la estructura corporativa. Esa lógica marcó su forma de conducir el área durante años de cambios para las consolas PS3, PS4 y PlayStation Vita.
Cómo fue la gestión de Kazuo Hirai en PlayStation
La desconfianza interna fue uno de los primeros obstáculos de su gestión. Hirai recordó que muchos trabajadores se preguntaban: “¿Cuándo nos va a quitar el suelo de bajo los pies?” o “¿Quizá es de los que se cuelgan el mérito y culpan a sus subordinados de los fallos?”.
El entonces director ejecutivo consideraba que la recuperación de la compañía requería reconstruir el vínculo con su personal. “Sin respeto, nadie va a pensar: ‘¡Vamos a trabajar duro juntos!’”, sostuvo.
Durante sus seis años al frente de Sony, viajó a más de 20 países y recorrió cerca de 50 ciudades. No se limitó a reuniones ocasionales: visitó oficinas y fábricas de distintos lugares y regresó varias veces a algunas de ellas, una presencia que sorprendía a los operarios de las líneas de producción.
Asimismo, la reorganización se articuló alrededor de KANDO, un concepto japonés referido a la creación de experiencias emocionalmente conmovedoras. Esa filosofía buscó unificar la cultura interna de Sony y acompañó la transición hacia la etapa de PlayStation 4.
En qué estado estaba PlayStation antes de la llegada de Kazu Hirai
Al asumir el mando de PlayStation en 2006, Hirai heredó el desastroso y costoso lanzamiento de PS3. En lugar de rendirse, orquestó una de las mayores remontadas de la industria: rediseñó la arquitectura de costes del hardware, impulsó el modelo PS Plus y apostó por un catálogo exclusivo inolvidable que logró superar a Xbox 360 en ventas globales.
Con esa misma visión de hardware premium, respaldó el lanzamiento de PS Vita, una máquina adelantada a su tiempo que, aunque sufrió la presión del mercado móvil, se convirtió en un objeto de culto técnico por su pantalla OLED y su integración portátil.
Esa intensa etapa sirvió como banco de pruebas para moldear la filosofía que definiría la época dorada de Sony. Hirai aprendió que el hardware debía ser amigable para los desarrolladores y centrado 100% en el jugador, una premisa que impregnó el desarrollo de PS4.
Al conectar la potencia de la nueva sobremesa, la experiencia en red perfeccionada en PS3 y el ecosistema interconectado con PS Vita mediante el juego remoto, Hirai dejó servido el camino para que PS4 arrasara en el mercado y devolviera a Sony al trono absoluto del videojuego.
Qué trayectoria tenía Kazuo Hirai antes de llegar a Playstation
Hirai había ingresado a CBS/Sony en 1984, atraído por la música y favorecido por su dominio bilingüe del inglés. Su infancia transcurrió entre Tokio, Nueva York y Toronto, una experiencia que contribuyó a su orientación hacia el entretenimiento y a su rechazo de la burocracia corporativa.
Al asumir la conducción general de Sony, aplicó esa misma autonomía mediante el plan One Sony. La estrategia implicó recortar divisiones históricas que generaban pérdidas, entre ellas la de computadoras VAIO, y redefinir el negocio de televisores.
Los recursos se concentraron en tres áreas: sensores de imagen, música y el ecosistema PlayStation. Esa reorientación devolvió la rentabilidad y el prestigio a la marca, mientras Hirai convertía una gestión marcada por la independencia de la división de videojuegos en un modelo para reorganizar el resto del grupo.

articles.title: Puces IA : Nvidia perd rapidement du terrain en Chine face à un Huawei conquérant
articles.text:
Le marché chinois des puces IA est important pour NVIDIA. Mais avec les contraintes imposées par Washington, la firme de Jensen Huang recule logiquement en 2026.
Faut-il ou non laisser la Chine acheter les puissants GPU de NVIDIA, destinés à entraîner les modèles d'IA ? Pour Jensen Huang, patron de NVIDIA, la réponse a toujours été évidemment oui, le milliardaire arguant que couper l'accès à la Chine ne ferait que la rendre plus indépendante, avec le développement de solutions alternatives locales. Et les derniers chiffres que l'on a sur les ventes semblent confirmer en partie sa prédiction.
La part de marché de NVIDIA dans les accélérateurs IA en Chine chute fortement en un an
Les contraintes géopolitiques issues de la rivalité entre la Chine et les États-Unis rendent les affaires de NVIDIA dans l'empire du Milieu toujours plus compliquée. Ce qui a aussi un impact sur ses ventes d'accélérateurs IA dans ce pays, comme nous le montrent les chiffres d'IDC, rapportés par Reuters.
Les ventes de puces IA NVIDIA en Chine ont ainsi, durant le premier semestre 2026, reculé de 44% par rapport à la même période l'an dernier. Résultat, sa part de marché dans le pays pour ce type de produit a réculé à 36%.
Huawei est de son côté en plein essor
De l'autre côté, par contre, c'est une ascension fulgurante que l'on peut observer pour l'entreprise locale la plus susceptible de remplacer un jour NVIDIA en Chine : Huawei. Le géant, qui a encore présenté en septembre dernier de nouvelles puces IA promettant une hausse sensible de puissance, voit en effet sa part de marché se rapprocher de NVIDIA, pour s'établir sur les six premiers mois de 2026 à 28%.
En parallèle, on peut observer que les ventes de GPU parmi les accélérateurs IA ont reculé de 26%, pour atteindre 991 000 unités vendues lors de la période observée. Les accélérateurs IA qui ne sont pas des GPU se sont ainsi plus vendus, grâce à une croissance de 80% sur un an, représentant 1,016 million d'unités écoulés.
Huawei, T-Head (Alibaba), Kunlunxin (Baidu) et Cambricon ont représenté 95% des ventes de ces accélérateurs IA non-GPU. Un format qui aurait été adopté en Chine, selon IDC, par les administrations publiques, les géants du Web et les opérateurs des télécoms. Alors, le découplage USA-Chine est-il en marche ?

articles.title: Microsoft closes a worrying Windows 11 account bypass hack — all it took was one click
articles.text:
Microsoft closes a worrying Windows 11 account bypass hack — all it took was one click
'Learn more' account bypass hack fixed
- Clicking 'Learn more' would skip Microsoft account demands when setting up Windows 11
- It now shows user data policies, so you'll have to sign in with your account (or create one)
- Having an account can make certain things easier, but it's one less choice for consumers
Microsoft has finally fixed one of the easiest ways for attackers to bypass its account requirements when installing Windows 11, but it's bad news for anybody who didn't want to sign in with – or create – a Microsoft account during setup.
Previously, users only had to click the 'Learn more' hyperlink on the sign-in screen to be taken to a local account creation screen.
Ultimately, it marks another step in the company's ongoing efforts to make Microsoft accounts mandatory during the initial setup of Windows 11 on consumer PCs.
Microsoft wants you to use an account to activate Windows 11
Before the fix, users could click the 'Learn more' link and be taken to a screen that allowed them to enter a local username, create a password, configure security questions and complete Windows 11 setup without ever entering their Microsoft username or password.
Instead, the link now opens a page that explains how the company managers user data.
The change "has been recently quietly patched server side," Bob Pony said in a Bluesky post after revealing that "a new method for skipping the mandatory Microsoft Account login in Windows 11 Home Edition has been discovered" just one month ago.
Local accounts remain supported to a certain degree, but creating them either requires technical knowledge to use a third-party tool or command-line methods, or enterprise versions of Windows rather than consumer-grade operating systems.

There are some benefits to signing in with a Microsoft account from the get-go, like speedier setup of system integrations with OneDrive, the Copilot app and other Microsoft products, however it eliminates user choice for those who prefer not to tie their PCs to their online account.

articles.title: Two Critical MarkLogic Flaws Could Give Delegated Managers Persistent Admin Control
articles.text:
Two of 31 newly disclosed flaws in Progress Software's MarkLogic Server database could let an account given only some management privileges take administrator control of the server, the company says.
Progress published all 31 on October 12 and scored five of them critical. Fixes have been available since September 10, in MarkLogic 11.3.7 and MarkLogic 12.1.0.
Affected releases, and the release that fixes each:
- MarkLogic 11.x before 11.3.7: upgrade to 11.3.7
- MarkLogic 12.x before 12.1.0: upgrade to 12.1.0
MarkLogic 11.3 is the long-term support (LTS) line. The 12 line, which Progress calls an innovation release, has no patched 12.0 release. Its fix is 12.1.0, which also adds new features.
Installing the fixes for the 10 MarkLogic flaws Progress disclosed in August is not enough. Those fixes arrived in 11.3.6 and 12.0.3, and both releases are affected by the new flaws.
Progress's CVE records and its upgrade notes for the two releases do not say whether any of the 31 flaws has been used in attacks. None was in the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog when The Hacker News checked on October 13.
The same records and notes list no workaround for customers who cannot upgrade yet.
What the Critical Flaws Allow
Progress scored three of the five critical flaws 9.9 out of 10 on the CVSS scale and the other two 9.6. For each one, the attacker must already have a privilege or a way to run code on the server, according to the company's CVE records.
Two of them involve forests. In MarkLogic, a forest is a collection of documents that is attached to a database.
| CVE | Score | What the Attacker Needs | What It Could Allow | 
|---|---|---|---|
| CVE-2026-85947 | 9.9 | Forest-management privileges | Create a persistent administrator account, potentially giving complete administrative control of the server | 
| CVE-2026-85948 | 9.9 | Manage-user-level privileges | Gain persistent administrative control, through an XQuery injection flaw in a deprecated Management API path | 
| CVE-2026-85955 | 9.9 | Query-execution access and the xdmp-eval-in privilege | Run server-side code with elevated permissions | 
| CVE-2026-85956 | 9.6 | Delegated database-administrator privileges | Back up or restore forests outside its own database, allowing access to or changes to what Progress calls "security-critical data" | 
| CVE-2026-9191 | 9.6 | The ability to run code through certain REST and XDBC evaluation paths | Perform unauthorized actions or compromise an authenticated session | 
The fix for CVE-2026-85947 shows which accounts are at issue. A "forest-scoped administrative grant" is no longer enough on its own to attach a forest to a database of the account's choosing, the upgrade notes say. They also tell customers to review delegated forest and database privilege assignments before upgrading, and to audit the roles that hold xdmp-eval-in.
Outside researchers reported four of the five through Bugcrowd. A researcher using the handle rexnets is credited with CVE-2026-85947, CVE-2026-85948, and CVE-2026-85956, and another using the handle WaltWhitehat is credited with CVE-2026-9191.
Flaws That Depend on Configuration
Progress scored 24 of the remaining flaws high and two medium. The highest, CVE-2026-85954, at 8.6, could allow an attacker to gain more privileges than granted by passing values to certain XQuery functions.
Several of the others apply only where a named feature or platform is in use:
- SAML: In deployments that use SAML authentication, an unauthenticated remote attacker could make the server accept an assertion it should reject (CVE-2026-85962). On 11.x, the SAML parser could also process external DTDs or entities (CVE-2026-85957).
- OAuth: An attacker could use a token that the server should not accept (CVE-2026-85958). The fix adds issuer and audience checks for Ping Identity and other OAuth configurations.
- Password-based Kerberos: In certain configurations, an attacker positioned on the network could impersonate the Kerberos authentication service (CVE-2026-85972).
- Cloud hosting: An authenticated attacker could access internal cloud services and obtain cloud credentials on Azure (CVE-2026-85951) and on Linux-based cloud deployments (CVE-2026-85952).
- Diagnostic logs: Under certain configurations, the server could write security-sensitive information to diagnostic logs (CVE-2026-85949 and, on Azure, CVE-2026-85961). AWS secret keys and session tokens were written in plaintext when the affected IAM trace path was enabled, the upgrade notes say.
- Amazon S3: Connections to S3 could use cleartext by default (CVE-2026-85975).
- Query Console: A remote attacker who gets a logged-in Query Console user to open a malicious page could run server-side code with that user's permissions (CVE-2026-85960). An authenticated Query Console user could read arbitrary server files (CVE-2026-85964).
- Legacy components: OpsDirector, a deprecated feature, could let an unauthenticated remote attacker make requests to internal services or forge trusted requests (CVE-2026-85963). Legacy InfoStudio modules could give access to server files (CVE-2026-85953).
The rest include three memory-safety flaws, a cross-site scripting flaw, HTTP response splitting in Query Console, inconsistent TLS hostname checks on some outbound connections, and cleartext cluster-management traffic on 12.x.
What the Upgrade Changes
Progress tells customers to read its upgrade notes, the known incompatibilities for 11.3.7 and those for 12.1.0, before upgrading. The 11.3.7 notes list behavior changes tied to 22 of the flaws, and the 12.1.0 notes to 21.
Changes that can break existing code, tools, or automation include:
- mlcp: Older versions of MarkLogic Content Pump (mlcp) fail against the new releases with an XDMP-ISOLATED error. Progress recommends mlcp 11.3.7 or 12.1.0. Older versions can run with -restrict_hosts set to true, which can reduce performance.
- Removed features: The /manage/v2/packages API, InfoStudio, and OpsDirector are removed.
- New defaults: XML external entity processing is off by default, S3 connections default to HTTPS, and new and rotated ErrorLog.txt and AuditLog.txt files are created with mode 0640 instead of 0666.
- Privileges: xdmp:eval-in() now needs both the xdmp-eval-in and xdmp-eval privileges. Reading Authorization headers needs a new privilege that no built-in role holds. Forest attachment, backup and restore are checked against every forest and database they touch.
- Stored secrets: FlexRep configuration responses no longer return stored passwords, client private keys or passphrases.
- Platform: MarkLogic 11.3.7 does not support Amazon Linux 2.
- Name conflicts: The upgrade can fail if the cluster already has a role, user or privilege with one of five names used by a new ticket system. The names are in the upgrade notes.
- Changes with no CVE attached: Both releases limit XML entity expansion and drop weak TLS ciphers from the defaults. On 12.1.0, Optic fragment queries return only document fragments by default.
On the fix for CVE-2026-85954, the notes warn: "As a result, you may no longer have privileges that you previously had access to, because that access was incorrect."
Some problems remain after the upgrade. Existing ErrorLog.txt and AuditLog.txt files keep their old permissions until they are rotated or recreated. The Kerberos fix needs a keytab, and without one, the server logs a warning and skips the new check.
Another flaw, CVE-2026-85959, meant successful logins were not always recorded in the audit log. Progress says that could limit a customer's ability to detect and investigate unauthorized access or credential misuse.
The CVE records and upgrade notes do not say whether upgrading removes an administrator account created through CVE-2026-85947 before the upgrade.
Second Batch Since August
The 31 flaws are the second batch Progress has disclosed for MarkLogic in 68 days. On August 5, it published 10, seven of them scored critical. One, CVE-2026-9192, was scored 9.8 and allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass password verification on the ODBC App Server, according to its CVE record.
Both times the fixes shipped first. The August flaws were fixed in releases dated July 1 and July 6, 35 and 30 days before their CVE records appeared. This time the gap was 32 days.
A search by The Hacker News of the U.S. National Vulnerability Database (NVD) on October 13 returned 49 CVE records that mention MarkLogic, 41 of them from these two batches. The other eight, from 2017 and 2018, are for Antenna House DMC HTMLFilter, a third-party component used by MarkLogic 8.0-6. Earlier MarkLogic releases also carried security fixes: the release notes for 11.3.1, 11.3.2 and 11.3.4 each mention "patches for security vulnerabilities" and name no CVE in the server's own code.

articles.title: Video | Así es el exoesqueleto robótico que permite “caminar” a personas con paraplejia
articles.text:
Jessica Tawil volvió a dar sus primeros pasos en más de una década con la ayuda de un exoesqueleto portátil. (Tomado de Instagram)
Jessica Tawil dio sus primeros pasos en más de una década con un exoesqueleto portátil, luego de que un accidente automovilístico ocurrido en Nueva Jersey, Estados Unidos, en noviembre de 2014 le provocara una lesión medular y la dejara paralizada de la parte inferior del cuerpo.
El video superó las 200 millones de reproducciones en Instagram, donde la joven de 27 años reúne más de 800 mil seguidores. La publicación acumuló más de 8 millones de me gusta y 140.000 comentarios.
Tawil tenía 16 años cuando sufrió el accidente. Desde entonces usa una silla de ruedas a diario y fue diagnosticada como parapléjica T6, una condición que le impide mover las piernas y la parte inferior de su cuerpo.
Aunque considera que posiblemente no vuelva a caminar de forma natural, el dispositivo le permitió ponerse de pie y avanzar. Al incorporarse, reaccionó con incredulidad: “Oh, Dios mío... está bien, está bien, está bien”.
Cómo es la tecnología detrás del exoesqueleto
Los exoesqueletos son estructuras que se colocan sobre el cuerpo y utilizan energía para asistir el movimiento de personas con parálisis. Suelen fabricarse con metal y fibra de carbono, e incorporan sensores que registran los desplazamientos del usuario.
En quienes no pueden mover las piernas, estos sistemas interpretan señales de la parte superior del cuerpo. Inclinarse hacia adelante o desplazar las caderas puede activar el inicio de un paso.
Algunos modelos, incluido el que utilizó Tawil, cuentan con controles situados en las muñecas para dirigir el movimiento. Otros incorporan botones desde los que el usuario puede ordenar cada acción.
La tecnología fue desarrollada durante años por científicos e ingenieros con el objetivo de ampliar la movilidad de personas con paraplejia. Sumado a permitirles caminar con asistencia, los investigadores han asociado su uso con efectos físicos y psicológicos.
Qué beneficios de salud traen los exoesqueletos
Un estudio publicado en 2022 en el Journal of Personalized Medicine señaló que caminar con un exoesqueleto puede fortalecer músculos afectados, mejorar la velocidad y la eficiencia de la marcha, y actuar sobre consecuencias secundarias de una lesión medular.
Los autores incluyeron entre esos posibles efectos la espasticidad, la densidad ósea, la masa corporal magra, el tono muscular, el dolor y cambios en las funciones cardiovasculares, de la vejiga y del intestino. A su vez, indicaron que se registraron mejoras en el estado de ánimo, la salud mental y la calidad de vida.
Cómo le fue a la creadora de contenido probando el exoesqueleto
En el video se observa el procedimiento mediante el cual la máquina eleva a la joven desde una banqueta hasta la postura erguida. Durante la sesión, dos especialistas permanecieron a su lado para supervisar la prueba e impartir instrucciones sobre la operación de los mandos del dispositivo.
A lo largo del ensayo, los técnicos explicaron a Tawil la manera de dirigir los controles para realizar giros a la izquierda y avanzar en línea recta por el recinto. El exoesqueleto sostiene el torso y las extremidades inferiores mediante correas y soportes rígidos, permitiendo el movimiento asistido de las piernas.
Hacia el final de la prueba, la creadora de contenido se desplazó hacia un espejo ubicado frente a los ventanales del establecimiento para observar la posición erguida con la estructura robótica colocada.
Asimismo, este tipo de tecnología médica basada en robótica, se utiliza en procesos de rehabilitación e investigación para proporcionar soporte físico y movilidad asistida a pacientes con parálisis o afectaciones en la columna vertebral.
Actualmente, el desarrollo de estos sistemas tecnológicos continúa en fase de evaluación clínica, con el objetivo de mejorar la autonomía funcional de los usuarios y analizar la viabilidad de su integración progresiva en espacios de uso personal y cotidiano.

articles.title: Menacée de fermeture, la célèbre plateforme Character.AI dépose le bilan
articles.text:
Character.AI s’est placé sous la protection du Chapter 11 aux États-Unis et cherche désormais un repreneur. Disney a posé une première offre à 20 millions de dollars sur certains actifs, mais la plateforme pourrait disparaître si la procédure n’aboutit pas à une solution permettant de poursuivre son activité.
Le service de chatbot IA fonctionne toujours, abonnements payants compris, mais son avenir se joue désormais devant un tribunal américain. En effet, la société vient d’engager une procédure de restructuration sous Chapter 11 et prévoit une vente de ses actifs qui devrait se conclure entre fin novembre et début décembre prochains.
Faute d’une offre de reprise permettant de maintenir le service, la plateforme pourrait tout simplement fermer. Un scénario assez spectaculaire pour l’une des premières start-up à avoir popularisé les conversations avec des personnages alimentés par l’IA.
Disney ouvre les enchères sans racheter Character.AI
Le groupe propose 20 millions de dollars pour une licence perpétuelle et non exclusive sur une partie de la propriété intellectuelle de Character.AI ainsi que certains droits détenus par l’entreprise. L’accord prévoit également des services de transition assurés avec d’anciens salariés de la start-up recrutés par Disney.
Il ne s’agit donc pas d’un rachat de la plateforme pour 20 millions de dollars. D’autres candidats peuvent présenter une offre supérieure, et Character.AI cherche également des repreneurs susceptibles d’acquérir la totalité ou l’essentiel de ses actifs. Le tribunal devra encore approuver les modalités de l’enchère puis la transaction retenue.
Disney retrouve un ancien dirigeant de Character.AI
Cette proximité ne sort pas de nulle part. Disney a récemment nommé Karandeep Anand au poste de directeur technique. Avant de rejoindre le groupe, il avait dirigé Character.AI pendant un peu plus d’un an et accompagné son virage vers les microdramas.
Les relations entre les deux entreprises n’ont pourtant pas toujours été paisibles. Disney reprochait à Character.AI d’héberger des chatbots utilisant sans autorisation certains de ses personnages et lui avait adressé des mises en demeure pour défendre sa propriété intellectuelle.
La start-up avait déjà perdu une partie importante de ses forces en 2024. Google aurait à l’époque versé environ 2,7 milliards de dollars dans le cadre d’un accord de licence technologique accompagné du recrutement des cofondateurs Noam Shazeer et Daniel De Freitas ainsi que d’autres membres de l’équipe.
Character.AI évoquait depuis des difficultés juridiques, réglementaires et opérationnelles, alors que plusieurs procédures avaient également relancé les débats sur la sécurité de ses chatbots.
Les utilisateurs peuvent déjà sauvegarder leurs données
Dans l’immédiat, rien ne change pour les abonnés. Character.AI continue de fonctionner normalement et la facturation reste active. L’entreprise prévoit de prévenir ses abonnés à l’avance si la procédure entraîne une modification des fonctions payantes.
Les utilisateurs gardent la possibilité de supprimer leur compte ou d’exporter leurs données depuis le site et l’application. Ceux qui souhaitent conserver certaines conversations ont donc intérêt à les sauvegarder dès maintenant…

articles.title: I tested the Braun OptiBrew Pro: an impressive drip coffee maker packed with extra features like over-ice brewing and a built-in milk frother
articles.text:
TechRadar Verdict
The Braun OptiBrew Pro is a drip coffee maker that makes excellent coffee, plus it offers some fun features you wouldn't expect. You can make a variety of different sizes ranging from a single serving to a full carafe. Make specialized cold brew or brew over ice. You can even froth your favorite milk with the built-in frother.
Reasons to buy
- + Great range of coffee styles and sizes
- + Makes seven sizes ranging from a single serving to a carafe
- + Makes cold brew and coffee over ice
- + Makes concentrated coffee shots
- + Built-in milk frother
- + Has timed auto-brew function
- + Has a keep-warm feature
- + Can pause brewing
- + Easy to use and clean up
- + Makes great coffee
Reasons to avoid
- - Must use pre-ground coffee
- - Milk frother only froths, does not heat milk
- - Somewhat pricey
Why you can trust TechRadar
We spend hours testing every product or service we review, so you can be sure you're buying the best. Find out more about how we test.
Braun OptiBrew Pro: two-minute review
The Braun OptiBrew Pro does even more than you might expect from a drip coffee maker. It makes five different coffee styles: Regular, Bold, Over Ice, Cold Brew, and Coffee Shot. There are seven different brew sizes: 8 ounces, 10 ounces, 12 ounces, 16 ounces, 20 ounces, a six-cup half-carafe, and a 12-cup full carafe. The Coffee Shot setting is not technically espresso but has a similar strength. This setting yields about three ounces of highly concentrated brew, perfect for making lattes and cappuccinos. A built-in milk frother tucks away when not in use.
The machine comes with a reusable filter, though you can use a cone-shaped #4 paper filter if you prefer. It also comes with a double-sided coffee scoop, so you can measure out the precise amount of coffee you need for each brew size and style.
The large, easy-to-read touch screen lets you set up your brew. You can adjust for high altitude and/or hard water if needed. Set up auto-brew for a specific time and you'll have freshly brewed coffee waiting for you when you wake up in the morning. The keep warm feature can keep your coffee warm for up to four hours at the temperature of your choice. You can also reheat cold coffee that way.
Cleanup is easy, and most of the parts are dishwasher-safe. The Braun OptiBrew Pro is easy to use, and it produces excellent coffee in a variety of styles.
Braun OptiBrew Pro: price and availability
- Available for purchase on Braun's website, Target, and Williams-Sonoma
- Retails for $199.95 (roughly £151.10 GBP, $287 AUD)
- Only one colorway: black and silver
The Braun OptiBrew Pro is available on Braun's website as well as other retailers such as Target and Williams-Sonoma. It comes in just the one colorway which is black with silver accents. The retail price is $199.95 (roughly £151.10 GBP, $287 AUD).
Braun OptiBrew Pro: specs
| Name | Braun OptiBrew Pro | 
| Type | Manual/Drip | 
| Dimensions | 6.9 x 14.6 x 11.8 inches / 175 x 370 x 300 mm | 
| Weight | 10.14 lbs / 4.6 kg | 
| Brew styles | Regular, Bold, Over Ice, Cold Brew, and Coffee Shot | 
| Milk frother | Yes | 
| Coffee bean grinder | No | 
Braun OptiBrew Pro: design
- Many features in compact machine
- Comes with everything you need
- Easy to use and clean
The Braun OptiBrew Pro is well-designed and has a lot of features for a compact drip brewer. The large and easy-to-read touch screen lets you set up whatever sort of brew you'd like. It comes with a reusable filter, but you can also use a #4 paper cone filter if you prefer.
The Braun OptiBrew Pro has a large capacity water tank on the back, which you can remove for easier filling if you like. The tank is marked with brew sizes so you can always be sure you have enough water in the tank for the size coffee you're making.
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
The milk frother tucks neatly away on the left side; simply swing it out to use it. Pressing the top of it turns it on, let go to turn it off. Twist it to the unlock symbol to remove the frother for cleaning. It's the only part that's not dishwasher-safe, but it's easy enough to wash up in the sink.
When you're making a single serving of coffee rather than a carafe, you can pull out a built-in platform that puts your mug close to the filter. This helps avoid any splattering and minimizes your coffee's contact with air. It's just the right height for a regular-to-large mug or a small-to-medium travel mug.
The included coffee scoop is two-sided, with one side being larger than the other. The user guide has a chart that tells you how many larger or small scoops to use for each brew style. This chart is a good guideline to start with, of course you can use more or less coffee to your personal tastes. The handle of the coffee scoop can be used as a coffee bag clip.
Other features include a keep-warm plate, which you can set for up to four hours, that you can also use to rewarm cold coffee. The OptiBrew has an auto-on feature so you can set up your coffee the night before.
If you wish to pause the brewing mid-carafe to grab a cup, you can easily do that by switching the lever in front from "coffee" to "stop."
Additionally, you can adjust for high altitude and water hardness if you need to. You can even adjust the beep tone if you like.
- Design score: 5/5
Braun OptiBrew Pro: performance
- Straightforward and simple to use
- Feature-rich
- Makes delicious coffee
I tested out lots of different brew styles, all of which made some delicious coffee. There's something on the menu for everyone.
Regular coffee
I started by making a half carafe of just regular drip coffee. I made it "bold" style, which is how I like it. I also used the maximum amount of recommended coffee, which was four big scoops. This came out great, nice and strong. Some carafes spill as they pour, but this one is well-designed and doesn't do that. I tested the brew pause feature by switching the lever from "coffee" to "stop" during brewing, poured myself a cup, and then switched the lever back to "coffee." Very little coffee dripped out while I was pouring a cup (maybe a drop or two) and when I switched the lever back, brewing continued as expected.
Regular coffee: single serving
I tried out some different single sizes of regular coffee, using the coffee dosage chart in the user guide. Each time I chose the maximum coffee dosage and selected the "bold" setting. I made a 12oz mug and a 16oz travel mug using the built-in platform. Both came out great.
View Original
View Original
View Original
View Original
Regular coffee: auto-on and keep-warm
If you want to have your coffee hot and ready for you when you wake up in the morning, use the auto-on feature. I tested this out and it worked perfectly. You can set the keep-warm feature to your desired time, up to four hours, so it will still be warm when you go for a second or third cup later. All of this worked exactly as expected. You can even set how warm you want your coffee to stay. I used the medium setting and found the coffee to be plenty hot even hours later. Hot enough that I had to blow on it before drinking. The red indicator light under the warming plate lets you know it's hot.
Cold brew
The Cold Brew setting takes a bit longer and brews the coffee at a lower temperature. It took about 12 minutes to brew 8oz of coffee. I found the brew to be quite smooth and tasty. I tasted it before adding ice and noticed that it was definitely lukewarm rather than hot. This minimizes ice melt. This feature was a real highlight for me, and rather unexpected for a drip coffee maker.
Brew Over Ice
If you don't have the time to wait for Cold Brew, the Brew Over Ice setting gets you to iced coffee in about 1/3 the time. It took about four minutes to brew an 8oz cup. However, I found it a little bitter, so for me the extra time for the Cold Brew setting is worthwhile.
Coffee shot and milk frother
To make a true espresso, you need an espresso machine, which uses pressure. This is a drip machine, so you can't make a real espresso. However, the Braun OptiBrew Pro does make an ultra-concentrated brew they call a Coffee Shot.
Frankly, I found it too strong to drink on its own, but it makes a great base for latte or cappuccino-style beverage. I used the milk frother and made myself a sort of cappuccino. Now, the frother only froths, it doesn't heat the milk, so the user guide suggests microwaving your milk first if you want hot foam. I did that and it worked out fine. I used 2% dairy milk and the foam was copious and quite sturdy. It even stood up to vigorous stirring. My drink was delicious! And the frother was easy to detach and wash afterwards.

Buy it if
You just want good coffee
At its heart, this is a drip coffee machine that makes excellent drip coffee.
You want a lot of different brew styles
It doesn't just make a carafe of drip coffee, it makes a variety of single serve sizes, has two different methods for iced coffee, and even brews a highly concentrated coffee shot for espresso-style drinks. It also froths milk for a cappuccino type of beverage.
You want some more fancy features
Set your coffee up in advance with the auto-on feature. Keep it warm or reheat it with the adjustable-temperature keep warm feature. You can adjust for high altitude or hard water. Even change up beep tone if you like.
Don't buy it if
It's too pricey
You can find a simple drip coffee maker without the bells and whistles for about a tenth of the price.
You want true espresso
Though the OptiBrew Pro makes a highly concentrated coffee shot that you can use like espresso for your frothed milk beverages, it isn't technically espresso. You need an espresso machine for that.
You are looking for an automatic bean-to-cup machine
There is no built-in grinder. You have to measure and scoop your ground coffee into the filter yourself. This is not an automatic or even semi-automatic machine, it's a manual machine.
Braun OptiBrew Pro: also consider
Ninja AutoBarista Pro Fully Automatic Espresso Machine
Want lots more bells and whistles? This automatic machine makes drip coffee, iced coffee, espresso, and milk-based drinks. Go from whole beans to cup with the touch of a button.

I made a Coffee Shot and added it to 2% milk that I had microwaved and then frothed with the built-in milk frother. I made both regular coffee and decaf. I utilized the auto on, keep warm, and pause during brewing functions. I cleaned the filter, filter holder, and milk frother after every use.

articles.title: Hollywood sería el próximo destino de Sora, la herramienta de video que OpenAI dejó de lado
articles.text:
OpenAI estudia dar un nuevo uso a Sora, su modelo de generación de videos con inteligencia artificial (IA), después de cerrar la aplicación dirigida al público en marzo. La compañía conversa con una startup que desarrolla herramientas de video para cineastas y que busca acceder a Sora para ofrecer programas y servicios destinados a la industria del cine, según informó The Information, citando a una persona familiarizada con las negociaciones.
La propuesta supondría un cambio de enfoque: Sora dejaría de presentarse como una aplicación general para crear y compartir videos y podría convertirse en tecnología para profesionales de la industria audiovisual. El acuerdo no se ha concretado. Según el reporte, OpenAI recibiría una participación en la startup si las conversaciones llegan a buen puerto.
La empresa emergente fue fundada por Jeffrey Katzenberg, exdirector de Disney y cofundador de DreamWorks; Bill Peebles, quien lideró la investigación de Sora en OpenAI; y Sujay Jaswa, exdirector financiero de Dropbox. La compañía mantiene un perfil discreto y su objetivo es desarrollar modelos de video y herramientas orientados a cineastas.
Del cierre de la aplicación a un posible uso profesional
OpenAI retiró Sora en marzo, cuando decidió concentrar sus recursos de computación y desarrollo en otras prioridades. Generar video requiere una gran capacidad de procesamiento, un recurso que la compañía también necesita para sus modelos y servicios de inteligencia artificial.
El cierre de la aplicación para consumidores fue un revés para quienes esperaban usarla en proyectos audiovisuales. También coincidió con el fin de la colaboración entre OpenAI y Disney, que había anunciado una inversión de 1.000 millones de dólares y un acuerdo para permitir el uso de personajes de sus franquicias en Sora. La alianza no llegó a materializarse como estaba prevista.
El nuevo planteamiento podría permitir que parte de la tecnología se aproveche en un entorno más especializado. En lugar de ofrecer una herramienta abierta para crear clips, la startup buscaría adaptar modelos y servicios a las necesidades de las producciones: desde tareas de creación visual hasta otras etapas del proceso cinematográfico. Sin embargo, el reporte no detalla qué funciones tendría el producto ni cuándo podría estar disponible.
La industria explora el uso de IA en el cine
La posible alianza aparece mientras estudios y empresas tecnológicas buscan formas de integrar herramientas generativas en la producción audiovisual. Para los grandes estudios, estas tecnologías pueden acelerar ciertas tareas y reducir costos; también podrían facilitar el uso comercial de catálogos de personajes y obras mediante licencias.
Al mismo tiempo, el avance de la IA genera preocupación entre guionistas, actores, artistas y otros trabajadores del sector. El uso de modelos para crear imágenes, voces o escenas plantea dudas sobre la sustitución de empleos, la remuneración de los creadores y el consentimiento para utilizar obras protegidas en el entrenamiento de sistemas.
Esas tensiones estuvieron presentes en las huelgas de Hollywood de 2023 y siguen formando parte del debate sobre las condiciones laborales y los derechos de autor. Una herramienta diseñada para profesionales no elimina esas preguntas: su impacto dependerá de los acuerdos sobre licencias, el control creativo y la manera en que los estudios la incorporen a sus producciones.
Un acuerdo aún sin confirmar
La negociación entre OpenAI y la startup no implica que Sora ya haya regresado ni que vaya a producir películas por sí sola. Por ahora, se trata de conversaciones reportadas por The Information, sin anuncio oficial de las compañías sobre los términos o el calendario.
Si se concreta, la operación podría abrir una vía para que OpenAI mantenga su tecnología de video en el mercado sin volver a la aplicación que cerró. También acercaría a la compañía a los estudios y cineastas en un momento en que Hollywood evalúa cómo aprovechar la IA sin dejar de lado los derechos de quienes crean sus contenidos.

articles.title: GitLab Patches CVSS 10.0 Flaw That Could Let Unauthenticated Users Run Server Code
articles.text:
GitLab has released patches for a maximum-severity security flaw impacting its Community Edition (CE) and Enterprise Edition (EE) software that could result in arbitrary code execution.
"GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation," the company said in a Monday advisory.
The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-97229, has been described as an integer overflow issue. It carries a CVSS score of 10.0. It affects the following versions -
- All versions from 19.2 before 19.2.8
- All versions from 19.3 before 19.3.5, and
- All versions from 19.4 before 19.4.2
Patches for the flaw are available in versions 19.4.2, 19.3.5, and 19.2.8. Also addressed are three high-severity bugs -
- CVE-2026-92883 (CVSS score: 8.7) - A cross-site scripting vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the context of other users' browser sessions via a specially crafted repository.
- CVE-2026-16301 (CVSS score: 8.5) - An improper authorization vulnerability in the downstream pipeline creation service that could allow an authenticated user with Developer role to execute CI/CD pipelines on protected branches.
- CVE-2026-14814 (CVSS score: 8.2) - A permissive regular expression vulnerability that could allow a user to poison cached responses for raw repository files, causing targeted users’ CI/CD pipelines to execute specially crafted content and potentially exposing protected environment variables.
The disclosure comes weeks after it remediated a critical flaw in AI Gateway (CVE-2026-90970, CVSS score: 9.9) that could have allowed an authenticated user with Duo Agent Platform access to break out of the prompt template sandbox via a specially crafted flow configuration and achieve arbitrary command execution on the AI Gateway.
Last month, another maximum-severity security flaw in GitLab CE and EE (CVE-2026-85706, CVSS score: 10.0) witnessed in-the-wild probes within hours of public disclosure.

articles.title: L’aspirateur-robot laveur Lefant M5 Pro passe sous la barre de 400€ grâce à cette petite astuce à connaître chez Amazon
articles.text:
L’aspirateur robot laveur Lefant M5 Pro est un modèle adapté à l’entretien quotidien des petits logements. Sur Amazon, il est actuellement possible de l’acquérir pour 399,98 € au lieu de 999,99 € grâce à l'association d'une remise immédiate et d'un coupon de réduction.
Tous les aspirateurs-robots laveurs avec station d’autonettoyage n’affichent pas un prix à quatre chiffres. Le Lefant M5 Pro est une référence de milieu de gamme adaptée aux petits logements sur un niveau, et il coûte actuellement 399,98 € au lieu de 999,99 € chez Amazon. Pour obtenir cette remise de 60%, il ne faut pas oublier d’activer le coupon de réduction de 50 €, présent sur la fiche du produit et valable jusqu’au 21 octobre 2026.
L’aspirateur-robot laveur Lefant M5 Pro revient à 399,98 € chez Amazon grâce à une remise immédiate et à un coupon de réduction.
Pourquoi choisir le Lefant M5 Pro ?
- Pour son rouleau de 20 cm : il est alimenté en eau propre pendant le nettoyage, tandis qu’une raclette récupère les saletés et l’eau usagée.
- Pour sa station automatique : elle collecte la poussière et lave le rouleau à l’eau chaude jusqu’à 75°C après chaque cycle.
- Pour sa gestion des tapis : le robot les détecte et relève son rouleau de 8 mm pour limiter leur contact avec l’humidité.
Un système de lavage adapté aux sols durs
Le Lefant M5 Pro est un aspirateur-robot laveurparticulièrement adapté aux logements dotés d’une majorité de sols durs, comme du carrelage, du linoléum ou encore du parquet. Néanmoins, pas d’inquiétude si vous avez des tapis, puisque l’appareil est capable de relever son rouleau de 8 mm pour éviter de trop les mouiller. Le rouleau-brosse qui équipe le robot est raclé et alimenté en eau propre en permanence, ce qui optimise grandement le nettoyage des sols. Au retour à la base, le rouleau bénéficie d’un nettoyage à l’eau chaude et d’un séchage à l’air froid. La poussière et l’eau sale sont automatiquement stockées respectivement dans un sac et dans un bac dédiés, présents dans la station.
Une station pratique, avec quelques concessions
La station multifonction qui accompagne le Lefant M5 Pro automatise certaines tâches d’entretien, ce qui s’avère pratique. Néanmoins, la capacité des réservoirs d’eau propre et d’eau sale est plus limitée que sur d’autres modèles d’aspirateurs plus haut de gamme, il faut donc intervenir manuellement plus souvent.
✅ Les points forts
- Rouleau lavant de 20 cm alimenté en eau propre.
- Lavage du rouleau avec une eau à 75°C.
- Collecte automatique de la poussière.
❌ Les limites
- Séchage du rouleau à l’air froid.
- Relevage de 8 mm peu adapté aux tapis épais.
Pour obtenir le Lefant M5 Pro à 399,98 €, pensez à cocher le coupon avant de passer commande.
L’aspirateur-robot laveur Lefant M5 Pro affiche un bon rapport qualité-prix pour les logements essentiellement composés de sols durs sur un seul niveau. Sa station multifonction permet de réduire les besoins d’intervention manuelle.
En revanche, si vous possédez beaucoup de tapis, c’est un modèle un peu moins adapté. Il faut aussi penser à acheter des sacs à poussière de remplacement afin d’en changer de temps en temps.

articles.title: À 18 ans, il gagne déjà sa vie en revendant des LEGO sur eBay, son activité a généré plus de 350 000 € en un an pour s'acheter son premier appartement
articles.text:
À 18 ans, il gagne déjà sa vie en revendant des LEGO sur eBay, son activité a généré plus de 350 000 € en un an pour s'acheter son premier appartement
Avec des millions de passionnés dans le monde, les Lego sont une vraie manne financière. Et à 18 ans à peine, Jamie Bell, qui vit au sud de Londres, a déjà généré un peu plus de 354 000 € de chiffre d’affaires par an dans la revente de lots sur eBay. Pour le bénéfice, c’est près de 59 000 € quand on retire l’achat du stock et les autres frais.
Et pas besoin d’avoir une collection rare. À 13 ans, Jamie Bell a d’abord commencé par vendre ses jouets. Puis à 14 ans, il achète son premier set Lego et revend les pièces séparément pour environ deux fois son prix d’achat. La stratégie est toute trouvée : écouler chaque figurine à l’unité sur sa page eBay, disponible à cette adresse.
Sur eBay, ses pièces LEGO s'écoulent en masse
C’est à 15 ans à peine que Jamie Bell a déjà acheté des stocks en masse pour les revendre à des collectionneurs et aux professionnels de la revente. "J’étais leur fournisseur", résume le jeune homme. Mais à 16 ans, son activité marche tellement qu’il doit faire appel à un expert-comptable.
Son activité a donc rapidement pris de l’ampleur autour de la ferveur des acheteurs de Lego. Lors de la première année, le jeune homme réalise environ 118 000 € de chiffre d’affaires puis 354 000 € l’année suivante, soit un triplement en un an. Bref, une activité qui rapporte.
Jamie Bell a donc trouvé un créneau de niche entre les gros vendeurs et les petits. Chaque mois, il écoule près de 100 kilos de Lego et sa boutique eBay affiche 2 900 ventes conclues et 100 % d’évaluations positives. Parmi les ventes de Jamie Bell, 95 kilos de figurines Lego Star Wars mis en vente au prix de départ de 1 € cette année.
Puis après 65 offres, le lot est parti à environ 26 500 €. Mais il ne s’agit pas de sa meilleure opération puisque le jeune homme confie que le lot lui a coûté très cher. Pour ses grosses ventes, on trouve notamment une enchère qui s’est terminée à environ 5 270 € ou encore la vente de deux figurines Lego Batman pour près de 890 €.
Selon Jamie Bell, environ 40 % de ses clients sont de gros collectionneurs avec un budget conséquent. Et parmi ces 40 %, il y en a 60 % qui achètent pour les revendre à l’unité. Jamie Bell gère lui-même l’activité, son père l’aide à expédier les colis et pour une partie de l’administratif. Quant au stock, il est stocké chez ses parents dans de grandes boîtes en carton.
Jamie Bell ne compte pas continuer dans la vente de Lego. Son avenir, il le voit à l’université, en train d’étudier l’histoire pour avoir une carrière bien plus stable. Une grande partie de ses revenus part dans son compte épargne avec comme objectif d’acheter un premier appartement.

articles.title: RimWorld's Switch to In-House Engine Promises Up to 400% Performance Boost
articles.text:
Tuesday, October 13th 2026
RimWorld's Switch to In-House Engine Promises Up to 400% Performance Boost
Despite launching in early access in 2013, RimWorld's developer, Ludeon Studios has just started a switch away from the Unity game engine to its own in-house Waylith engine with update 1.7. In a new blog post, the developer notes that the switch away from Unity could result in performance improvements of "2-4×," while claiming an identical gameplay experience. 
In the studio's in-house testing, game load time, startup time, world and map generation, and general tick-per-second performance all saw significant performance improvements. A stress test with a "late game colony" saw a performance improvement of 2.2×, although the studio didn't exactly share test parameters beyond that. Load times of a mod pack with 1,500 mods also improved from 14 minutes to 6 minutes. The studio notes that individual performance improvements on the new engine will depend on PC specs, but those are promising improvements if scaling holds up.The Waylith Engine is currently available for testing in the RimWorld 1.7 beta branch, and Ludeon adds that the new game engine not only plays the same, but it should also require minimal intervention from modders and players. Save games from 1.6 should load without problems, and "the vast majority of mods" will work without changes. The new engine also promises additional C# language features for mod developers and should make it easier to write complex mods without affecting game performance. 
The only catch that Ludeon points out is that older PCs may not support the new game engine, but it encourages players to reach out via Discord for assistance, as "we may be able to make some changes to help." 
This is only the latest instance that highlights the importance of custom game engines in an industry in which we are seeing more and more game studios move away from custom engine development in favor of the likes of Unity and Unreal Engine.

articles.title: La preventa del iPhone Duo arranca este viernes 16 de octubre de 2026: el primer plegable de Apple cada vez más cerca
articles.text:
Apple iniciará la preventa del iPhone Duo, su primer teléfono plegable, el viernes 16 de octubre de 2026. La compañía, dirigida por John Ternus, lo ofrecerá desde USD 1.999 y comenzará a venderlo el viernes 23 de octubre.
El precio variará según la capacidad de almacenamiento:
- 256 GB: USD 1.999
- 512 GB: USD 2.199
- 1 TB: USD 2.599
- 2 TB: USD 3.199
Cuando está plegado, el equipo cuenta con una pantalla externa de 5,4 pulgadas que ofrece el 90% de la superficie de pantalla del iPhone 18 Pro, en un diseño compacto que cabe en el bolsillo. Como ambas pantallas comparten la misma relación de aspecto, el contenido se adapta de forma proporcional para mantener la continuidad visual.
Características del iPhone Duo
El iPhone Duo es el primer teléfono plegable de Apple y combina una pantalla exterior de 5,4 pulgadas con un panel interior de 7,6 pulgadas.
Cuando está cerrado, ofrece el 90% de la superficie de pantalla del iPhone 18 Pro en un formato compacto; al abrirse, amplía el espacio disponible para ver contenido, jugar y usar varias aplicaciones a la vez.
Ambas pantallas Super Retina XDR comparten la misma relación de aspecto, por lo que el contenido se ajusta de manera proporcional al plegar o desplegar el equipo.
Incluyen tecnología ProMotion, pantalla siempre activa y un brillo máximo de 3.000 nits en exteriores. Además, la pantalla interior tiene un acabado nanotexturizado que reduce los reflejos y minimiza la visibilidad del pliegue.
Apple fabricó el dispositivo con titanio de grado 5, Ceramic Shield en la parte posterior y Ceramic Shield 2 en el frente.
El teléfono cuenta con certificación IP68 de resistencia al agua, las salpicaduras y el polvo. Su bisagra, compuesta por más de 100 piezas, fue diseñada para controlar la apertura y reforzar la estructura.
El sistema fotográfico incorpora una cámara Fusion principal de 48 MP, con teleobjetivo de calidad óptica de 2x, y una cámara Fusion ultra gran angular de 48 MP para capturas más amplias y fotografías macro.
Suma una cámara frontal Center Stage, que permite tomar fotos y grabar videos en cualquier orientación sin girar el teléfono.
El iPhone Duo puede grabar video 4K Dolby Vision a 120 fps y ofrece efectos cinematográficos que pueden aplicarse después de la grabación. Su diseño plegable permite apoyar el equipo sobre una superficie para realizar videollamadas o grabar sin trípode.
Touch ID está integrado en el botón lateral, mientras que el Control de la Cámara permite abrir rápidamente la app fotográfica.
El equipo utiliza el chip A20 Pro, un sistema de cámara de vapor y dos baterías que funcionan como una sola.
Apple afirma que ofrece hasta 31 horas de reproducción de video con la pantalla interior y hasta 44 horas con la exterior. iOS 27 incorpora Split View para usar dos apps lado a lado, compatibilidad con Apple Intelligence y una nueva versión de Siri capaz de interpretar el contexto personal del usuario.
Apple lanza nuevos dispositivos para el hogar
Apple presentó Apple Home Collection, una línea de accesorios para hogares inteligentes desarrollada junto con LG Electronics y Schneider Electric. La línea incluye cámaras para interiores y exteriores, timbres con cámara, cerraduras inteligentes, termostatos y sensores de temperatura y humedad.
La línea de LG incorpora cuatro cámaras capaces de grabar video en resolución de hasta 2,5K. Los dispositivos pueden identificar personas, rostros conocidos, mascotas, vehículos y paquetes.
Ofrecen hasta 10 días de historial de video mediante planes compatibles de iCloud+ y almacenamiento local para mantener las grabaciones aun cuando se interrumpa la conexión Wi-Fi.
La cerradura Smart Deadbolt Lock de LG utiliza tecnología de banda ultraancha para reconocer cuándo el usuario se aproxima a la puerta.
Puede desbloquearse automáticamente con una llave de casa guardada en un iPhone o Apple Watch compatible, además de contar con teclado numérico y una llave física de respaldo.
Apple también anunció termostatos inteligentes de LG y Schneider Electric. Estos equipos ajustan la temperatura según la presencia de personas, los horarios de descanso o la ausencia de residentes. Los sensores adicionales permiten medir la temperatura y humedad en diferentes habitaciones.

articles.title: Low-Cost Android Phones Ship With Preinstalled Malware That Turns Them Into Residential Proxies
articles.text:
Low-cost Android smartphones have been shipped with malicious software baked into the device firmware, allowing bad actors to covertly install apps, conduct ad fraud, and turn devices into residential proxies.
The activity, which targets Android devices built on MediaTek platforms across several brands, is being tracked by Bitdefender under the moniker Midnight Mimosa.
The preinstalled malware ("com.android.system.lite") runs with system-level privileges, which make it possible to install or uninstall a rotating set of at least 32 disguised apps, grant itself additional permissions to accessibility services, notifications, and SMS, and load arbitrary code supplied remotely by the operators.
Specifically, it fetches a remote configuration from an external server and then downloads and executes additional payloads designed to conduct ad fraud and silent installation or removal of partner apps. These apps incorporate proxyware, ad fraud, and code execution features. It can also grant permission to any Android app package.
"This essentially means its operators could install and delete apps at will, tuning each device to their needs, including making them part of large botnets," the Romanian cybersecurity company said.
"This scheme is likely designed mainly to generate revenue. The operators carry out ad and click fraud, collect device and installed-app information, and turn infected devices into residential-proxy relay nodes, making them zombies in botnets."
It's worth emphasizing that the malware itself doesn't engage in fraudulent clicks. Instead, the monetization effort is driven by dropper apps that masquerade as seemingly harmless utility apps, which are responsible for loading genuine ads through a legitimate advertising software development kit (SDK). The end goal is to load an invisible window on top of apps that registers the ads being shown.
In all, Bitdefender said it discovered 13 apps on Google Play that communicate with the same servers that control the malware, indicating the campaign is not limited to preinstalled firmware. Unlike the preinstalled malware, the Play Store apps provide genuine functionality, such as weather information or QR-code scanning. But they also load and display ads outside the apps, including when a user is not actively using the phone.
The names of the apps are listed below. None of them are currently available for download from the Play Store -
- Wavrge (com.audify.editor.wavrge)
- App Icon DIY (appicon.diy.tools.prop)
- Audify (com.audify.editor.pro)
- QR Pocket (com.prorestore.qr)
- All Deleted Messages Recovery (com.message.recovery.prorestore)
- WeatherGo (com.go.weather.mot)
- CoolWeather (com.cool.weather.yl)
- Daily Weather (com.dmstudio.weather)
- Lock & Hide (com.dl.guard.lock)
- QuickText Extractor (picturetranslate.extractor.text.lite)
- NoteMaster (com.notemaster.record.mark)
- Tap to Translate (com.arabmusic.tap.aghani_tamerhosny)
- Tasky (org.life.goal.tools)
A notable aspect of the malware is that it disables the Google Play Store app prior to installing a payload app, likely in an attempt to bypass Play Protect safeguards, and then re-enable the app after the payload is run.
What's more, the malware has been detected on devices with firmware signed using certificates attributed to Shenzhen Zediel Co., Ltd, a Chinese Android device manufacturer. However, it's unclear at this stage if the certificate owner was involved in or aware of the malware deployment. However, Bitdefender noted that it also detected other company names over the course of its investigation.
The preinstalled nature of the malware suggests a compromise of the device supply chain, with Bitdefender highlighting some level of infrastructure overlaps with Android.Phantom, which was documented by Doctor Web in January 2026 as bundled within modded games and popular apps to conduct click fraud.
The vast majority of the infected devices are located in Mexico, followed by France, Italy, the U.S., Germany, Brazil, Spain, the U.K., Canada, Romania, Poland, and Thailand. Collectively, the campaign has been observed on thousands of unique devices across more than 150 countries over roughly two years. Many of the impacted phones appear to be low-cost, white-label or counterfeit devices, including models that borrow the names of better-known Samsung Galaxy phones and even Apple iPhones.
This is not the first time a firmware-level backdoor has been observed targeting Android devices. Late last year, Kaspersky disclosed details of another malware codenamed Keenadu that was discovered preinstalled on certain models of tablets running Android to primarily enable ad fraud.
"Preinstalled malware is a different threat class," Bitdefender said. "Every user-facing defense assumes the owner is in the loop at installation: the install prompt, the store review, Play Protect, and the ability to uninstall afterwards."
"Remediation cannot rely on uninstall. Because the root component ships in the system partition, an affected owner cannot remove it by the normal route. Clearing the device requires firmware-level cleanup or disabling the component over ADB, and neither is realistic for most people who own these phones. The durable fix sits with the vendors and the marketplaces that ship and sell the affected firmware."

articles.title: Microsoft change la façon de créer les applications sur Windows 11
articles.text:
Enfin, Microsoft permet plus de liberté aux développeurs avec WinUI Gallery 3.0 ! Cette nouveauté tant attendue va faciliter la création d'applications pour Windows 11.
Microsoft a modifié le fonctionnement de son application de démonstration destinée à la conception de logiciels sous Windows 11. La mise à jour vers WinUI Gallery 3.0 intègre désormais des composants expérimentaux issus du Windows App SDK, ce qui permet aux développeurs de tester de nouvelles commandes plus tôt dans leur cycle de développement, de manière à faciliter la création de certaines apps.
Un ajout des éléments d'interface anticipé
Jusqu'alors, les éléments d'interface n'étaient ajoutés à WinUI Gallery qu'après la sortie d'une version stable du Windows App SDK. Cette organisation limitait la capacité de Microsoft à ajuster ces commandes en fonction des retours des utilisateurs. Avec l'arrivée du SDK expérimental dans la version 3.0, les créateurs d'applications peuvent tester les fonctionnalités en amont et transmettre leurs remarques à temps pour orienter les modifications.
Cette version comprend ainsi de nouveaux exemples de commandes expérimentales, comme TableView, Charts, Wrap Panel et LayoutPanel, élaborés pour présenter les données de manière plus lisible.
Niels Laute, chef de produit senior chez Microsoft, a également détaillé plusieurs ajustements pratiques apportés à l'application :
- Navigation à la souris : les boutons précédent et suivant de la souris permettent désormais de naviguer dans l'interface de la galerie, à l'image du fonctionnement d'un navigateur web.
- Amélioration de la recherche : des balises de recherche ont été ajoutées sur chaque page de contrôle. Saisir des termes comme « context menu », « carousel » ou « WCAG » permet de trouver la page correspondante, même lorsque le terme recherché ne figure pas dans le nom précis du contrôle.
- Gestion des recherches sans résultat : en l'absence de résultat, l'application affiche la requête saisie, des conseils de recherche et un bouton redirigeant vers l'ensemble des exemples.
WinUI Gallery : des différences entre les deux outils
Présente sous différents noms depuis 2018, WinUI Gallery fait office de vitrine numérique pour le développement sur Windows. L'application permet de visualiser l'aspect des éléments d'interface sur un PC et d'accéder à des exemples de code conformes au cadre de design de l'éditeur. Bien qu'elle soit peu destinée aux utilisateurs finaux, elle constitue un outil de travail pour la création d'applications sur Windows 11.
Sur le plan de la terminologie, dans son grand art de faciliter les choses, Microsoft distingue l'application WinUI Gallery 3.0, qui désigne cette mise à jour spécifique de l'outil de démonstration, de WinUI 3, qui correspond au framework de développement actuellement utilisé par les programmeurs.

articles.title: Xbox Won't Survive Without New IP, Warns CEO Asha Sharma
articles.text:
Tuesday, October 13th 2026
Xbox Won't Survive Without New IP, Warns CEO Asha Sharma
Xbox CEO Asha Sharma told staff at an internal town hall last week that the division needs new IP to survive, according to transcripts obtained by Windows Central from multiple sources. Sharma apparently said Xbox will keep betting on its biggest franchises, though she also wants the studios to keep making new games, and she framed that second part as a matter of survival. Sharma did tell The New York Times earlier this month that Xbox is not for sale, so it seems the plan is a smaller Xbox that still takes some creative risks. Here's what she reportedly said:
We're backing our strongest franchises. I want our great games to become great global billion-dollar franchises. I would also like to see us continue to create enduring new IP. We will not survive if we only revive on the past. We have to find new ways, and courage, to have invention on new IP, that reaches new sets of audiences.
The comments arrive three months after Xbox announced it would cut around 3,200 jobs through FY27, with Double Fine and Compulsion Games going independent as part of the "reset." Ninja Theory staff have since reported layoffs as the Hellblade studio moves toward closure, and Obsidian has reportedly had several projects canceled. People were quick to point out how odd the message sounds, given that Double Fine and Compulsion, two studios that recently shipped new IP for Xbox, are no longer part of it. How many new games actually get greenlit is something readers can judge over the coming year.
Source:
				Windows Central

articles.title: Les champignons noirs de Tchernobyl ont été étudiés par des scientifiques, ce qu’ils cachent pourrait devenir précieux pour les futures missions spatiales
articles.text:
Les champignons noirs de Tchernobyl ont été étudiés par des scientifiques, ce qu’ils cachent pourrait devenir précieux pour les futures missions spatiales
Et si les champignons noirs que l’on trouve dans les ruines de Tchernobyl aidaient l’humain à franchir l’un des plus gros obstacles des voyages vers la Lune et Mars ? Des chercheurs étudient la capacité de ces champignons à encaisser de fortes doses de radiation qui détruisent les cellules humaines, avec comme objectif d’en réduire une partie. Une piste étonnante qui pourrait permettre de concevoir des protections spatiales que les astronautes pourraient produire loin de notre chère Terre.
C’est en 1997 et 1998 que des scientifiques ukrainiens explorent l’intérieur du réacteur numéro 4 de Tchernobyl. Dedans, ils trouvent 37 espèces de champignons dans des zones encore très contaminées. Beaucoup étaient noirs à cause de cellules avec beaucoup de mélanine, un pigment qui colore également la peau humaine.
Des champignons noirs résistants aux radiations
Parmi les espèces les plus présentes dans les zones où la radioactivité était la plus forte, le Cladosporium sphaerospermum. Et c’est justement ce champignon qui a vite intrigué les chercheurs car il ne se contente pas de survivre à l’environnement hautement irradié : il se développe près des sources de radiation.
En 2007, une étude a montré que les radiations modifiaient les propriétés de la mélanine et amélioraient la croissance de plusieurs champignons noirs. Et justement, les radiations amélioraient la croissance du Cladosporium sphaerospermum même lorsque la nourriture disponible était faible.
L’important dans ces recherches, c’est donc la mélanine, un pigment qui peut protéger les cellules contre une partie des dégâts causés par les radiations. Selon les scientifiques, il pourrait aider certains champignons à puiser de l’énergie dans ces rayons. Un principe qui ressemble à la photosynthèse des plantes mais ici, la source n’est pas une lumière visible. Les chercheurs parlent de radiosynthèse, même si pour le moment le mécanisme exact n’est pas encore démontré.
Mais alors pourquoi parle-t-on de voyages spatiaux en introduction ? Tout commence avec une expérience menée à bord de la Station spatiale internationale. Des chercheurs ont fait pousser Cladosporium sphaerospermum face aux radiations de l’orbite avec des capteurs placés sous la culture. La croissance fut environ 21 % plus rapide que lors d’un test fait sur Terre.
Les capteurs ont aussi enregistré moins de radiations sous le champignon que sous la zone témoin. Notons toutefois que l’échantillon dans la Station spatiale internationale venait d’un laboratoire et pas directement du réacteur de Tchernobyl. Des observations qui permettent aux chercheurs d’envisager une protection pour Mars.
Des champignons pour protéger les astronautes
Les boucliers classiques ajoutent beaucoup de masse, ce qui augmente fortement le coût et complique le lancement d’une mission. Le champignon a un avantage : celui qu’une petite quantité peut partir de la Terre, puis ensuite être cultivée dans l’espace. Les chercheurs étudient même des matériaux qui pourraient mélanger cette biomasse à la poussière de Mars.
Le but serait de créer des parois capables de réduire l’exposition des astronautes dans un habitat. La mélanine pourrait aussi être utilisée dans des matériaux pour les combinaisons ou certaines structures. D’autres travaux évoquent ces champignons pour recycler des déchets biologiques et produire des molécules utiles lors des longues missions.
On l’oublie souvent mais les radiations sont l’un des grands problèmes des voyages loin de la Terre puisque nous sommes protégés ici grâce à l’atmosphère et à son champ magnétique. Lorsque l’on se rend sur Mars, on sort de cette protection et forcément, l’équipe est exposée aux particules du Soleil et aux rayons cosmiques. Les risques de cancers et de dégâts biologiques augmentent lors d’une longue exposition.
Bien évidemment, le champignon noir trouvé à Tchernobyl ne va pas faire qu'un vaisseau soit une forteresse spatiale de sitôt. Mais les chercheurs se penchent dessus avec la possibilité de le faire pousser en se reposant sur sa capacité à se renouveler et le produire loin de la Terre. Bilan : une forme de vie découverte dans les ruines d’une catastrophe nucléaire pourrait donc épauler les scientifiques pour envoyer des humains beaucoup plus loin dans le système solaire.

El mensaje “código inválido o expirado” indica que la clave dejó de estar vigente o ya alcanzó su límite de uso.
Qué premios pueden obtener los jugadores de Free Fire
